items.en: I lay on the newsroom sofa with my laptop yesterday.
items.tl: Ich lag gestern mit dem Laptop auf dem Redaktionssofa.

items.en: You were lying sick in bed during the server outage.
items.tl: Du lagst während des Serverausfalls krank im Bett.

items.en: The confidential report lay open on her desk.
items.tl: Der vertrauliche Bericht lag offen auf ihrem Schreibtisch.

items.en: We were far off the official figures with our forecast.
items.tl: Wir lagen mit unserer Prognose deutlich neben den offiziellen Zahlen.

items.en: You all lay exhausted in the break room after the night shift.
items.tl: Ihr lagt nach der Nachtschicht erschöpft im Ruheraum.

items.en: The files lay unchecked at the regulator's office on Monday.
items.tl: Die Akten lagen am Montag ungeprüft bei der Aufsichtsbehörde.

items.en: The editor doubts that I know who leaked the report.
items.tl: La editora duda que yo sepa quién filtró el informe.

items.en: It is vital that you know how this app tracks data.
items.tl: Es vital que tú sepas cómo rastrea datos esta aplicación.

items.en: The regulator requires that she know who finances the platform.
items.tl: El regulador exige que ella sepa quién financia la plataforma.

items.en: It is advisable that we know when they will publish the new sanctions.
items.tl: Conviene que nosotros sepamos cuándo publicarán las nuevas sanciones.

items.en: The director wants you all to know how to spot manipulated headlines.
items.tl: La directora quiere que vosotros sepáis detectar titulares manipulados.

items.en: The judges insist that they know how to protect their sources.
items.tl: Los jueces insisten en que ellos sepan proteger sus fuentes.

items.en: The boss expected me to tell the truth about the failure.
items.tl: El jefe esperaba que yo dijera la verdad sobre el fallo.

items.en: Nobody would believe the rumor even if you said who warned you.
items.tl: Nadie creería el rumor aunque tú dijeras quién te avisó.

items.en: The network denied that she said that during the interview.
items.tl: La cadena negó que ella dijera eso durante la entrevista.

items.en: The minister preferred us to say less about the negotiations.
items.tl: El ministro prefería que nosotros dijéramos menos sobre las negociaciones.

items.en: It would be better if you all clearly said who approved the algorithm.
items.tl: Sería mejor que vosotros dijerais claramente quién aprobó el algoritmo.

items.en: The lawyer doubted that they told the committee the whole truth.
items.tl: El abogado dudaba que ellos dijeran toda la verdad al comité.

items.en: The producer asks me to view the cut before the news bulletin.
items.tl: La productora pide que yo vea el montaje antes del informativo.

items.en: I hope you soon see how the platform manipulates your preferences.
items.tl: Ojalá tú veas pronto cómo la plataforma manipula tus preferencias.

items.en: The committee wants him to see the evidence without filters.
items.tl: El comité quiere que él vea las pruebas sin filtros.

items.en: It is crucial that we see who buys political advertising.
items.tl: Es crucial que nosotros veamos quién compra publicidad política.

items.en: The editor orders you all to watch the complete documentary.
items.tl: La editora ordena que vosotros veáis el documental completo.

items.en: I doubt they see the risks of automating the newsroom.
items.tl: Dudo que ellos vean los riesgos de automatizar la redacción.

items.en: The board doubts that I want to censor this embarrassing report.
items.tl: Le conseil doute que je veuille censurer ce reportage embarrassant.

items.en: I doubt that you want to entrust your data to this platform.
items.tl: Je doute que tu veuilles confier tes données à cette plateforme.

items.en: Nobody believes that she wants to buy this failing media outlet.
items.tl: Personne ne croit qu'elle veuille racheter ce média déficitaire.

items.en: The editor doubts that we want to publish these violent images.
items.tl: Le rédacteur doute que nous voulions publier ces images violentes.

items.en: It seems unlikely that you want to defend this opaque algorithm.
items.tl: Il semble improbable que vous vouliez défendre cet algorithme opaque.

items.en: Regulators doubt that they truly want to limit biometric surveillance.
items.tl: Les régulateurs doutent qu'ils veuillent réellement limiter la surveillance biométrique.

items.en: I used to obey algorithmic alerts, but now I check every source.
items.tl: Moi qui obéissais aux alertes algorithmiques, je vérifie désormais chaque source.

items.en: You used to obey the platform's deadlines without arguing.
items.tl: Tu obéissais sans discuter aux délais imposés par la plateforme.

items.en: The moderator used to obey management's secret instructions.
items.tl: Le modérateur obéissait autrefois aux consignes secrètes de la direction.

items.en: We routinely obeyed the editorial rules, even during diplomatic crises.
items.tl: Nous obéissions aux règles éditoriales même pendant les crises diplomatiques.

items.en: You still obeyed the alerts before disabling the application.
items.tl: Vous obéissiez encore aux alertes avant de désactiver l'application.

items.en: The newsroom reporters rarely obeyed the algorithm's automated recommendations.
items.tl: Les rédacteurs obéissaient rarement aux recommandations automatiques de l'algorithme.

items.en: With this exclusive investigation, I will be worth more on the market.
items.tl: Avec cette enquête exclusive, je vaudrai davantage sur le marché.

items.en: After this certification, you will be worth more to recruiters.
items.tl: Après cette certification, tu vaudras davantage aux yeux des recruteurs.

items.en: In five years, this platform will be worth several billion euros.
items.tl: Dans cinq ans, cette plateforme vaudra plusieurs milliards d'euros.

items.en: We will be worth two billion after merging with our main competitor.
items.tl: Nous vaudrons deux milliards après la fusion avec notre principal concurrent.

items.en: After this investigation, you will be worth a lot on the job market.
items.tl: Après cette enquête, vous vaudrez cher sur le marché du travail.

items.en: These patents will be worth millions after the new regulation passes.
items.tl: Ces brevets vaudront des millions après l'adoption du nouveau règlement.

items.en: Would you check the sources before publishing this accusation, please?
items.tl: Per favore, vuoi controllare le fonti prima di pubblicare questa accusa?

items.en: Director, please verify the data personally before the live broadcast.
items.tl: Direttrice, voglia verificare personalmente i dati prima della diretta.

items.en: Shall we verify these figures before alarming the public?
items.tl: Allora, vogliamo verificare questi numeri prima di allarmare il pubblico?

items.en: Colleagues, please flag every conflict of interest in the shared document.
items.tl: Colleghi, vogliate segnalare ogni conflitto d'interessi nel documento condiviso.

items.en: Let the delegates hand in their phones before the confidential meeting.
items.tl: I delegati vogliano consegnare i telefoni prima della riunione riservata.

items.en: I will want concrete guarantees before entrusting sensitive data to the platform.
items.tl: Io vorrò garanzie concrete prima di affidare dati sensibili alla piattaforma.

items.en: You will want to read the contract before the algorithm analyzes your messages.
items.tl: Tu vorrai leggere il contratto prima che l'algoritmo analizzi i tuoi messaggi.

items.en: He will want explanations when the newspaper silently corrects the article.
items.tl: Lui vorrà spiegazioni quando il giornale correggerà silenziosamente l'articolo.

items.en: We will want independent evidence before supporting the new regulation.
items.tl: Noi vorremo prove indipendenti prima di sostenere il nuovo regolamento.

items.en: You all will want to know the risks before approving that merger.
items.tl: Voi vorrete conoscere i rischi prima di approvare quella fusione.

items.en: They will want to check the facts before the press conference.
items.tl: Loro vorranno controllare i fatti prima della conferenza stampa.

items.en: I learned about the data leak only after publication.
items.tl: Io seppi della fuga di dati soltanto dopo la pubblicazione.

items.en: You learned about the secret deal when the minister left Brussels.
items.tl: Tu sapesti dell'accordo segreto quando il ministro lasciò Bruxelles.

items.en: She managed to manipulate the algorithm without leaving visible traces.
items.tl: Lei seppe manipolare l'algoritmo senza lasciare tracce visibili.

items.en: We learned about the censorship through a diplomatic source.
items.tl: Noi sapemmo della censura grazie a una fonte diplomatica.

items.en: You all managed to anticipate the crisis better than government analysts.
items.tl: Voi sapeste anticipare la crisi meglio degli analisti governativi.

items.en: They learned about the information blackout through local journalists.
items.tl: Loro seppero del blocco informativo attraverso i giornalisti locali.

items.en: Rui, come to the newsroom before the platform deletes the records.
items.tl: Rui, vem à redação antes que a plataforma apague os registos.

items.en: Director, come see the data before the press conference.
items.tl: Senhora diretora, venha ver os dados antes da conferência de imprensa.

items.en: Colleagues, let us come prepared to discuss the law with regulators.
items.tl: Colegas, venhamos preparados para discutir a nova lei com os reguladores.

items.en: Members of parliament, come hear the journalists before the vote.
items.tl: Senhores deputados, venham ouvir os jornalistas antes da votação.

items.en: I used to come early to review the international headlines.
items.tl: Eu vinha cedo à redação para rever os títulos internacionais.

items.en: You used to come to meetings with data contradicting the algorithm.
items.tl: Tu vinhas às reuniões com dados que contradiziam o algoritmo.

items.en: He used to come every Friday to inspect server security.
items.tl: Ele vinha todas as sextas-feiras verificar a segurança dos servidores.

items.en: We used to come prepared to challenge the platform's forecasts.
items.tl: Nós vínhamos preparados para contestar as previsões da plataforma.

items.en: They came from Brussels whenever a regulatory crisis arose.
items.tl: Eles vinham de Bruxelas sempre que surgia uma crise regulatória.
